math_translation: Rate of moral entropy change equals sin source term minus redemption current divergence.
plain_translation: Moral disorder grows when sin enters faster than grace can remove it.
theological_translation: Judgment is not God adding disorder; it is the natural accounting when grace is refused.

math_translation: A selection operator acting on a state vector yields a projection that resolves to one actual outcome.
plain_translation: A choice collapses possibilities into one real result.
theological_translation: Faith is the act that receives one actuality from the open set the laws permit.

math_translation: Rate of explicit moral-entropy change equals sin-source term minus the divergence of the redemption current.
plain_translation: When wrongdoing enters faster than forgiveness removes it, moral disorder accumulates.
theological_translation: Clausius-Judgment names the moral version of the second law: grace can reverse the current, but not without cost.

math_translation: Einstein field equations: spacetime curvature is proportional to the stress-energy tensor.
plain_translation: Matter and energy tell space how to curve.
theological_translation: Grace (Newton-Grace) is the geometric response of creation to the presence of mass-energy.

math_translation: Rate of change of the Logos/K variable equals information gain minus a self-limiting saturation term.
plain_translation: Understanding grows with revelation but levels off as it approaches capacity.
theological_translation: Logos increases by hearing and is bounded by creaturely capacity; pride is the quadratic drag.

math_translation: Placeholder rate equation using undefined prose factors and an ellipsis.
plain_translation: This is a sketch, not a finished equation.
theological_translation: Theological terms must be given rigorous definitions before they can carry weight in a rate equation.

math_translation: Density-matrix element decays exponentially with faith-distance between states i and j.
plain_translation: Two possibilities interfere less when they are far apart in faith-space.
theological_translation: Faith sets the coherence length between spiritual possibilities; unbelief is distance.

math_translation: A time/observable operator is the integral over time of a projector, Hamiltonian, and state.
plain_translation: Time is measured by the accumulated pattern of events and their energy.
theological_translation: The grace-frame integrates observer, history, and state into one measured sequence.

math_translation: Outcome probability equals base quantum probability modulated by a faith factor and relative phase.
plain_translation: The chance of a result is adjusted by how much faith and alignment are present.
theological_translation: Faith does not override probability; it enters as a measurable modifier of the weights.

math_translation: Entropy rate equals the sum of all alignment-gap contributions minus a restoration term depending on the Law variable.
plain_translation: Disorder grows with every way the system is out of alignment, minus the repair effect of judgment.
theological_translation: Sin fragments; righteousness restores. Net entropy is the balance.
